Butter chicken pasta. My go to slow cooked dinner. If there is one thing I love making that saves me time and my sanity, it’s slow cooked dinners. MAGGI makes this super easy with their butter chicken recipe base that is a great solution for those busy weeknights when mum life is in full swing. My family is obsessed with this meal! INGREDIENTS  2 chicken breasts.  1/4 cup tomato paste.  2/3 thickened cream.  1 tbsp butter.  1 packet MAGGI butter chicken recipe base.  1 brown onion, diced.  1 cup water.  300g penne pasta.  Salt and pepper.  METHOD  Turn slow cooker onto low and add all the ingredients except for the pasta.  Cook for 6 hours.  Boil pasta just before serving.  Meanwhile with two forks pull the chicken apart. Drain the cooked pasta and pour into the slow cooker.  Mix through. Portion out into bowls, season with more salt and pepper if needed and enjoy! #AD #MAGGI @maggianz

Not all congestion sounds in babies mean they’re sick — and that surprises a lot of parents. Because babies start life primarily breathing through their nose, even tiny changes inside these very narrow nasal passages can make them sound dramatically congested. Things like: • Dry air • Crying • Milk reflux • Bathing • Small mucus buildup …can sometimes create congestion sounds that feel almost exactly like a cold, even when there isn’t actually an infection.
